Author:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Jun 11 11:49:12 2026 -0400
Commit:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Jun 11 11:49:12 2026 -0400

    Bug 2046682 - Port bug 2046273: Follow-up, replace resolve_keyed_by with task-context where possible/sensible. rs=bustage-fix DONTBUILD

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/bouncer-locations/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/bouncer-locations/kind.yml
index 88c7f87d997..cc063f3aad9 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/bouncer-locations/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/bouncer-locations/kind.yml
@@ -18,8 +18,8 @@ task-defaults:
     run-on-repo-type: [hg]
     description: nightly bouncer locations job
     task-context:
-        from-custom:
-            - release-level
+        from-parameters:
+            project: project
         substitution-fields:
             - scopes
     attributes:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/mark-as-merged/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/mark-as-merged/kind.yml
index de13c7b3908..072a48f44eb 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/mark-as-merged/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/mark-as-merged/kind.yml
@@ -6,6 +6,7 @@ loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader
 
 transforms:
     - taskgraph.transforms.from_deps
+    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.mark_as_merged:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
 
@@ -15,6 +16,11 @@ kind-dependencies:
 task-defaults:
     run-on-repo-type: [hg]
     description: mark merge automation as completed in shipit
+    task-context:
+        from-custom:
+            - release-level
+        substitution-fields:
+            - scopes
     worker-type: shipit
     from-deps:
         kinds:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-check/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-check/kind.yml
index d1900af3b90..3798132a20e 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-check/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-bouncer-check/kind.yml
@@ -9,6 +9,7 @@ kind-dependencies:
 
 transforms:
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
+    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.bouncer_check:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.job:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
@@ -17,6 +18,14 @@ task-defaults:
     run-on-repo-type: [hg]
     name: release-bouncer-check
     description: release bouncer check
+    task-context:
+        from-parameters:
+            release-type: release_type
+        from-custom:
+            - release-level
+        substitution-fields:
+            - run.config
+            - run.extra-config
     run-on-projects: []  # to make sure this never runs as part of CI
     shipping-phase: push
     worker-type: b-linux
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-flatpak-push/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-flatpak-push/kind.yml
index 98d97434e1d..aa51b29496f 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-flatpak-push/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-flatpak-push/kind.yml
@@ -7,6 +7,7 @@ loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader
 transforms:
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release:run_on_releases
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
+    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_flatpak_push:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
 
@@ -19,6 +20,14 @@ task-defaults:
     run-on-projects: []  # to make sure this never runs as part of CI
     run-on-releases: [beta, release, esr140]
     shipping-phase: ship
+    task-context:
+        from-parameters:
+            release-type: release_type
+        from-custom:
+            - release-level
+        substitution-fields:
+            - worker.channel
+            - worker-type
     treeherder:
         platform: linux64/opt
         kind: build
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-generate-checksums/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-generate-checksums/kind.yml
index 79fbd9a52dd..6cc8af521fe 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/release-generate-checksums/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/release-generate-checksums/kind.yml
@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@ kind-dependencies:
 transforms:
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.build:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_deps:transforms
+    - taskgraph.transforms.task_context
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_generate_checksums:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.job:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
@@ -19,6 +20,12 @@ task-defaults:
     run-on-repo-type: [hg]
     name: generate-checksums
     description: generates checksums
+    task-context:
+        from-custom:
+            - release-level
+        substitution-fields:
+            - run.config
+            - run.extra-config
     run-on-projects: []  # to make sure this never runs as part of CI
     shipping-phase: promote
     worker-type: b-linux
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/release-msix-push/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/release-msix-push/kind.yml

     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release:run_on_releases

     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release_msix_push:transforms
     - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task:transforms
 
@@ -19,6 +20,14 @@ task-defaults:
     run-on-projects: []  # to make sure this never runs as part of CI

+    task-context:

+            release-type: release_type

     treeherder:
         platform: win32-shippable/opt
         kind: build
